noun_definition: Report field refers to a customizable field in the workspace settings of the application that allows users to add and manage list values for reporting purposes.
List value refers to the individual entries that can be added to a dropdown selection in the Report fields settings, which are expected to be displayed in alphabetical order.
Alphabetical order refers to the arrangement of list values in a sequence based on the standard order of the letters in the alphabet, as expected in the Report fields settings.
